title: odontochilus montanus
intro: Odontochilus montanus, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid or Himalayan snake grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Odontochilus montanus include wound healing, antiseptic properties, and the ability to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
